import json,numpy as np,hashlib; from pathlib import Path
trusted=json.loads(Path('/mnt/input/trusted.json').read_text()); originals=[]
for r in trusted['rows']:
 p=Path('/source/reconstruction')/r['artifact'];assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==r['sha256']
 with np.load(p,allow_pickle=False) as a:originals.append(np.column_stack((a['xyz'],a['physical_features'][:,1])))
original=np.concatenate(originals)
with np.load('/mnt/output/packed.npz',allow_pickle=False) as p:
 indices=p['source_indices'];counts=p['counts'];coords=p['coordinates'];points=p['points'];valid=indices>=0; retained=indices[valid]
 assert points.shape==(*indices.shape,4) and len(counts)==len(indices) and coords.shape==(len(indices),4)
 assert np.all(counts==valid.sum(1)) and np.all(counts>0) and np.all(counts<=32); assert len(indices)<=20000
 assert np.all(indices[~valid]==-1) and np.all(points[~valid]==0);assert len(retained)==len(np.unique(retained));assert np.all(retained<len(original))
 np.testing.assert_array_equal(points[valid],original[retained]);xyz=points[valid,:3];assert np.all(xyz>=np.array([-64,-64,-3])) and np.all(xyz<np.array([64,64,5]))
 actual_xy=np.floor((points[:,:,:2]+64)/.25).astype(np.int64); expected=np.broadcast_to(coords[:,None,[3,2]],actual_xy.shape);np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual_xy[valid],expected[valid]);assert np.all(coords[:,:2]==0)
 assert len(np.unique(coords[:,2]*512+coords[:,3]))==len(coords)
check={'status':'independent native source/ROI/cell/padding/index checker passed','source_records':len(originals),'input_points':len(original),'retained_points':len(retained),'pillars':len(indices),'packed_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path('/mnt/output/packed.npz').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'scope':'engineering preparation only'}
Path('/outputs/check.json').write_text(json.dumps(check,indent=2));print('PASS independent native packing checker',check)
